data.one_liner: A lightweight, in-memory HNSW vector index for Dart and Flutter supporting fast ANN search.
data.what_it_does: Provides an in-memory vector index for performing fast approximate nearest neighbor searches using cosine or Euclidean similarity. Allows adding, searching, deleting, saving, and loading vectors natively in Dart.
use_when: You need on-device vector search or embeddings matching in Dart or Flutter
You want a pure Dart implementation without native dependencies
You need to save and load small vector indices locally
avoid_when: You require a persistent embedded database for massive enterprise-scale vector collections
You need complex vector filtering that goes beyond basic distance metrics
strengths: Pure Dart implementation with no native dependencies
Supports both cosine and Euclidean similarity metrics
Includes built-in save and load serialization methods
weaknesses: In-memory storage means indices must be serialized and reloaded for persistence
Not documented for scaling to millions of high-dimensional vectors compared to specialized native vector databases
data.setup_notes: No native setup or dependencies required.
